# Goldens for rd_shadow_fine_ab (port/render/test/rd_shadow_fine_ab.cmake, check 1):
# the SHA-256 of every PNG the rd_replay_tool of the release before (v0.11.6)
# wrote with --pass-dump --stats, on the expanded fixtures of shadow_fine.txt,
# at each setting the test runs with ICO_RD_SHADOW_FINE=0 (the script's header
# gives each setting's environment and arguments; force and the OpenGL settings
# have none), on lavapipe (Mesa 25.0.7, LLVM 19.1.7).  They pin the fixtures'
# own pictures (generated data, none of the game's): the PS2-size chain must
# give these bytes.  A change that moves these frames' pictures on purpose
# regenerates them: the same runs with the tool of the release before.
# Fields: the fixture, the setting, the PNG, its SHA-256.
